name: Confetta
tagline: The CRM for wedding pros who'd rather not lose a $90k booking in a group text.
positioning: Confetta is the enterprise CRM built for wedding vendors juggling hundreds of couples, vendors, and deposits — without the chaos of spreadsheets and lost DMs.

hero.h1: Book the wedding. Not the nervous breakdown.
hero.sub: Confetta keeps every couple, contract, deposit, and timeline in one place — so your planners stop reconstructing the whole event from a florist's voicemail at 11pm.

features.title: Deposits that don't ghost you
features.description: Track every retainer, balance, and payment plan across hundreds of couples. Automatic nudges chase the ones who 'totally meant to send it last week.'

features.title: One timeline, zero group texts
features.description: Ceremony, reception, and vendor logistics live in a shared timeline. When the DJ moves load-in, the caterer and coordinator find out instantly.

features.title: Contracts that survive audits
features.description: Templated agreements, e-signatures, and a full change log per booking. Legal stops emailing you asking which version the couple actually signed.

features.title: Vendor roster, actually organized
features.description: Every florist, band, and rental partner with rates, availability, and reliability scores — so your team stops re-vetting the same no-show caterer.

features.title: Pipeline for peak season
features.description: See which inquiries are worth chasing before June eats your calendar. Forecast bookings and staffing weeks out, not the morning of.

features.title: Reporting the C-suite believes
features.description: Revenue per venue, seasonality, and vendor margins in dashboards your CFO won't quietly rebuild in a spreadsheet.

testimonials.quote: We run 40 planners across nine markets. Before Confetta, our source of truth was a shared inbox and prayer. Now onboarding a new coordinator takes a day, not a quarter.
testimonials.name: Renata Voss

testimonials.quote: The deposit tracking alone paid for the contract. We recovered six figures in balances that were just... sitting in someone's DMs.
testimonials.name: Desmond Achebe

testimonials.quote: I was skeptical of another CRM promising to fix wedding season. Confetta actually did. My planners stopped texting me at midnight, which is the real ROI.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadella

pricing.blurb: For boutique teams tired of running weddings out of a spreadsheet.

homepage.footerBlurb: Confetta is the wedding vendor CRM for teams that treat 'happily ever after' as an operational problem. Fewer group texts. More booked weekends.
